title: ESI contribution due dates
description: When the contributions of a wage period fall due and by when they are paid: on the last day of the wage period (section 29(4) of the Code on Social Security, 2020), or of the employment in it for an employee employed for part of it (regulation 36), and paid within 15 days of the last day of the calendar month in which they fall due, or on the last day of a permanent closure (regulation 31), the regulations being those of the Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 1950, in ESIC's consolidated text, kept in force by section 164(2) of the Code. Section 164(2)(b) keeps them “for a period of one year from the date of commencement of this Code”, 21 November 2025 for them, so their rows end on 20 November 2026, the earlier day on which that year may end, and the Code's own row runs on. The set answers for the last day of the wage period.

cells.name: Contributions of a wage period fall due
cells.wording: (4) The contributions payable in respect of each wage period shall ordinarily fall due on the last day of the wage period, and where an employee is employed for part of the wage period, or is employed under two or more employers during the same wage period, the contributions shall fall due on such days as may be specified in the regulations.

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 1950, regulation 36, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 11.01.2024

cells.name: Contributions of part of a wage period fall due
cells.wording: 36. Employment for part of a wage period. Where an employee is employed by an employer for part of a wage period, the contributions in respect of such wage period, shall fall due on the last day of the employment by such employer in that wage period.

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 1950, regulation 31, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 11.01.2024

cells.name: Contributions are paid
cells.wording: 31. Time for payment of contribution. An employer who is liable to pay contributions in respect of any employee shall pay those contributions within 15 days of the last day of the calendar month in which the contributions fall due:

rows.source: Employees' State Insurance (General) Regulations, 1950, regulation 31, first proviso, in ESIC's consolidated text as on 11.01.2024

cells.name: Contributions are paid on a permanent closure
cells.wording: 31. Time for payment of contribution. An employer who is liable to pay contributions in respect of any employee shall pay those contributions within 15 days of the last day of the calendar month in which the contributions fall due: Provided that where a factory/establishment is permanently closed, the employer shall pay contribution on the last day of its closure:
